messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
I'll pull that up for you now.

Hi Jeff, your B30 on Shop···· hasn't shipped yet. It ships October 30, along with the Miner Duster and Power Kit in the same box.

That batch is on its way to us now, and you can follow it here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Tracking goes to (email hidden) as soon as the label prints. Anything else I can check for you?
Before you go, one thing: has the wait on the B30 had you thinking about changing or dropping that order?
Yes, you guys take so long to deliver these products

That's fair, Jeff, and I'm sorry. You ordered in July and the date moved once already.

What happened is the B30 cooling was redesigned to make the unit quieter, which pushed the batch. Yours is built and allocated to you, not sitting on a shelf, and it leaves on October 30 with the Power Kit we added free on September 15 for the wait.

You can watch the batch move here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Want me to keep an eye on it and confirm once the label prints?
You guys also offered the dust fan as well for free

You're right, Jeff. The Miner Duster is on the order too, it went on where the Overclocking bundle was. So the box has the B30, the Miner Duster and the Power Kit, all shipping together on October 30.

Anytime, Jeff. Your tracking will land in your inbox as soon as the label prints.

One last thing, if you don't mind: when the wait drags, would you rather hear from us on a set schedule, or only when the date actually moves?
I would like for you guys to keep your word and stop promising things you guys can’t handle

Understood, and you're right to call it. We moved your date once and that shouldn't have happened after you'd already waited.

So I'll keep this one plain: October 30 is the date on your order, and if anything changes you'll hear it from us first, not after the fact. No extra promises from me beyond that.
